pages.title: Power of Movement
pages.text: A trophy left after defeating the Herald of Storm. Its arrival shows you survived the first trial of the cycle.$(br2)The heart embodies the $(l:beginning/paths)$(#1C7FA8)Path of Movement$()$(/l).

pages.title: Heart of Storm
pages.text: Right-click the Echo of the Beyond with the heart in hand to lower the $(l:beyond/pursuit)Pursuit$(/l) meter by 100.
